name: messagefoundry-ci-npm-tools
description: The npm tools CI runs: jscpd (quality-advisory.yml) and cyclonedx-npm (security.yml). CI installs them with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from the committed package-lock.json, which pins every transitive dependency by integrity hash. The `npx --yes <tool>@<version>` this replaced pinned the top package only and resolved the rest fresh on every run (vault BACKLOG #2793). jscpd stays on 4.x: npm `latest` is a 5.x rewrite with a different CLI. The glob override holds it on its patched line (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4; glob 14 in turn needs a minimatch past GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249): cyclonedx-npm reaches glob through the optional libxmljs2 > node-gyp > make-fetch-happen > cacache chain, and cacache still asks for glob ^10. The minimatch and @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match overrides only hold those two on releases older than dependabot.yml's three-day cooldown. Dependabot is not known to move an override, so bump or drop all three by hand; drop the glob one once cacache resolves a patched glob on its own.
